description: This file defines the ContactsService class, which implements contact management functions such as searching for contacts and adding new contacts, using the Contacts framework. It includes methods for authorization, contact retrieval, normalization, and deduplication.

classes.name: ContactsService
classes.description: A final class responsible for managing contacts, including searching, adding, and deduplication. It interacts with the Contacts framework and handles authorization.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches contacts matching a query or retrieves contacts with a limit.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new contact or returns an existing one matching provided details.

methods.name: ensureAuthorization
methods.description: Checks and manages the authorization status for accessing contacts.

methods.name: normalizeStrings
methods.description: Trims whitespace and optionally lowercases a list of strings.

methods.name: findExistingContact
methods.description: Finds an existing contact matching given phone numbers or emails.

methods.name: matchContacts
methods.description: Matches contacts based on normalized phone numbers and emails.

methods.name: normalizePhone
methods.description: Extracts and normalizes phone digits from a string.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Creates a payload object from a CNContact.
